title: Campus cloud drive upload failure
input: At 14:20 today, the campus cloud drive in Teaching Building A could not upload PDFs and displayed 503. Downloading existing files worked. Changing browsers did not fix the problem.
description: Separate observed evidence from the unknown scope of impact.

title: Cloud lab desktop connection timeout
input: At the start of the third class, six students in Computer Room B kept seeing connection timeout when opening their cloud lab desktops. The teacher could log in normally. No one has tried restarting the lab yet.
description: Keep direct quotations and avoid inventing a root cause.

title: Course video buffering
input: Last night, course videos buffered every ten to twenty seconds over campus Wi-Fi in the dormitory. Playback worked after switching to mobile data. The exact time was not recorded.
description: Identify missing information without inventing timestamps or network metrics.
